subject: Make Journal Jerusalem wall asset real, then verify product monitor

argv: set -e; target=static/images/jerusalem-wall.png; if [ ! -s "$target" ]; then found=$(find /Users/chenjingyu -type f \( -iname 'jerusalem-wall.png' -o -iname '*jerusalem*wall*.png' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true); if [ -n "$found" ]; then mkdir -p static/images; cp "$found" "$target"; fi; fi; test -s "$target"; git add "$target"; if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then git commit -m 'design: restore Journal Jerusalem wall asset'; git push origin HEAD:main; fi; python3 dore-design/journal_import.py; bash dore-design/install-macos.sh; python3 dore-design/product_monitor.py

body: Hardening gate. Use the real existing Jerusalem wall asset if it exists locally; do not invent or substitute a fake wall. The task passes only when static/images/jerusalem-wall.png is a real non-empty asset, Journal import/service is refreshed, and product_monitor no longer emits JOURNAL_COVER_ASSET_MISSING. After this gate, Storybook runtime bootstrap is the next milestone, followed immediately by real visual design work. Do not alter the locked approved homepage design in this task.
